newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Acer rises on reported IBM order.
newsitem.headline: Acer rises on reported IBM order.

text.p: Acer Inc, Taiwan's computer giant, surged at mid-morning on Friday on media report that it had received US$1 billion in orders from International Business Machines Corp, brokers said.
* The Economic Daily News reported on Friday that Acer had recently gained a big order worth US$1 billion from IBM, agreeing to produce 500,000 notebook computers in 1998 for IBM.
* An Acer spokeswoman declined to comment. "Acer will not comment on such reports as we have signed non-disclosure agreements," she said.
* After 85 minutes at 0225 GMT, Acer was up T$3 or 3.55 percent to T$87.5. Turnover was the market's sixth highest.
* Brokers said Acer was a good target for long-term investment.
* Michael Hung, independent analyst: "Acer is a good buy in the long term. Demand for notebook computers keeps on rising, so Acer will receive more orders in addition to the reported IBM orders."
